notes: S2 (§13, §15: a verifier reports, it never crashes): F51: the declaration has no body.key. Its self-signature names a key that nothing in the context declares, so key resolution (step (4)) makes it unverifiable E_KEY_UNKNOWN. The record sits in a container next to a declaration and a key-compromise revocation of the same key, so the input reaches every stage that reads lifecycle bodies before their kind schema is checked.
